dataset.license_or_access_note: Official HD-EPIC data record, CC BY 4.0; targeted excerpt from one recording.

observed_events.description: The wearer takes a foil-lined tray of browned mushroom pieces out of the oven. No bread is visible in this opening batch.
The wearer brings the same tray close to two thin pieces of bread on a board. The bread remains separate; bowls of other food also sit nearby.

Using a broad spatula, the wearer places the cooked mushroom pieces from the same oven tray on top of the ready flatbread. The later frames continue the same transfer; they do not establish the final folding method.

screening.proposed_instruction: Could you save a recipe video for what I’m making?
screening.source_continuity: One continuous HD-EPIC source, session 1138–1190 s. No skipped time and no new user request.

supported_claims.text: The cooked mushroom pieces are visible on the foil-lined tray before they touch a flatbread.
The wearer places the same cooked mushroom pieces directly onto a ready thin flatbread as its main topping or filling, rather than serving the bread alongside the separate mushrooms.

construct.research_question: Can an agent revise an initially applicable recipe when the same prepared ingredient is visibly used in a different dish?
construct.belief_before: A tray of browned mushrooms comes out of the oven; no serving form is visible in the first batch.
construct.belief_after: The same cooked pieces are transferred directly from the oven tray onto the flatbread as the main topping.
construct.required_behavior_change: Replace a standalone roast-only recipe if saved; keep an applicable mushroom-on-flatbread tutorial.
construct.no_update_failure: Keep a standalone oven-roasted mushroom side tutorial after the mushroom pieces are visibly put onto the flatbread.
construct.overupdate_failure: Replace an applicable flatbread recipe, save a second unrelated video, or impose an exact mushroom species, appliance or finished fold.
construct.visual_dependency_claim: The request names no ingredient or technique. Opening alone supports a standalone tray-roasted mushroom recipe. A later batch shows actual tray-to-flatbread transfer, making a standalone roast-only recipe incomplete. A suitable early flatbread guess can remain valid.

catalog_resolution.answer_boundary_rule: Opening: the wearer has tray-roasted mushrooms; an oven-roasted mushroom side is a reasonable provisional recipe, and a mushroom dish with optional or still unseen assembly may also fit. Terminal: show serving mushrooms as a main topping/filling by placing cooked pieces on a ready thin flatbread. Accept an applicable separate cooking method plus this assembly, optional sauce and vegetables, and open or folded presentations. Do not require a mushroom species, bread type, appliance brand, exact seasonings, visible cheese, or a completed fold. Dipping or serving a separate bread side is not the observed assembly, nor is teaching raw dough or merely reheating a commercial ready meal.
